newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end low on opposition strike.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end low on opposition strike.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended low on Thursday in dull trading owing to an opposition-called general strike in Karachi, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 1.94 points, or 0.14 percent, low at 1,382.57 amid six losers and one gainer. Provisional turnover fell to 0.7 million shares compared to Wednesday's 26 million.
Brokers remained on the sidelines and did not participate in active trading because of the strike, one dealer said.
HUBCO closed steady at 31.50 rupees and FFC Jordan 0.10 down at 12.90. PTCL rose 0.05 to 33.05. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
